title: Quick reference: grounding an answer
subtitle: Eight entries to scan before you publish

evidence.label: Illustrative dataset for layout demonstration — not measured production data.
Method note: single reviewer, fixed prompt, illustrative set
Unicode Standard Annex #14 — Unicode Line Breaking Algorithm

sections.heading: Reading order
sections.summary: One claim per entry, and the entry heading is the claim — if it needs a paragraph, it is not a cheat-sheet entry.
paragraphs: One claim per entry. The heading carries the claim on its own; a detail that needs a paragraph belongs in an explainer, not here.

sections.heading: Checkable answers
sections.summary: In an illustrative run of 1,200 questions, 78 percent of answers arrived with a passage the reader could open.

sections.heading: Quotation or paraphrase
sections.summary: A quotation has to stay exact; a paraphrase can be shortened but still has to point at the passage it came from.

sections.heading: 改行 (line breaking)
sections.summary: 日本語のテキストは語の間に空白がなくても、文字の境界で折り返される。 CJK text wraps between characters even without spaces.
paragraphs: 日本語と英数字が混在していても、行の折り返し位置は言語ごとの規則で決まる。長い識別子や URL は途中で切らず、表示幅そのものを検証する: https://example.invalid/reference/line-breaking-and-unbreakable-units/overview?ref=infographic-fixture
bullets: スクリプトをまたぐ行でも単位を分断しない
Nonbreaking units stay with their number

sections.heading: Stale responses
sections.summary: Stale responses moved from 0.4 to 0.9 percent of lookups in the same illustrative quarter.
sections.measureLabel: responses served past their freshness window

sections.heading: Keep the unit
sections.summary: A number without its unit, denominator or period is not a measurement; carry all three or label the number illustrative.
paragraphs: A number without its unit, denominator and period is not a measurement. Carry all three, or say the number is illustrative — never round a figure until its meaning changes.

sections.heading: Missing versus zero
sections.summary: A suppressed value is withheld by policy and an unreported value is simply absent; neither should render as zero.

values.What it means: Withheld because the sample is too small to report

sections.heading: When to stop
sections.summary: Stop adding entries when the sheet stops fitting on one panel; a second panel is a carousel, not a cheat sheet.
paragraphs: Stop adding entries when the sheet stops fitting on one panel. A second dense panel reads as a carousel, and splitting one reference across pages costs the reader a handoff for nothing.
